text.line.m.a1.12.arrival.1: Quite a place you have here. I came to see what the Yard is worth, and now I think I should ask you.
text.line.m.a1.12.fog: The helicopter lost you in the fog. A few cruisers are still on your tail. Shake them.
text.line.m.a1.12.home: The Yard gate is lit. Bring the truck in and let the pod's story ride home with you.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot: Look at the screen. That is our street with a number on it. Get in the car, they are coming.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot-one.1: Every curb in this city is a lot. Lot number one is a street called home. Our crews begin tonight.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot-one.2: Units to the plaza. Take the driver in the plain car, and nobody gets hurt.
text.line.m.a1.12.msg: Big screen at the plaza by the arena. I am going live in a minute. Do not miss this.
text.line.m.a1.12.run: Security is rolling out. Helicopter, spike strips, everything they have. Stay moving for two minutes, no matter what.
text.line.m.a1.12.start: Saint here, live. They are about to put a number on the Yard. Get to the plaza by the arena and watch the big screen.
text.line.m.a1.12.talk.whitney.open: I run a fund that has a stake in this auction. Before anyone writes a headline, would you like to hear what I can do for the Yard?
text.mission.m.a1.12.fail.ride: Your car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.12.obj.escape_fog: Lose the patrol in the fog
text.mission.m.a1.12.obj.goto_plaza: Go to the plaza by the arena
text.mission.m.a1.12.obj.talk_whitney: Hear out the investor at the gate
text.mission.m.a1.12.title: Lot Number One
